capabilities: Streams AI conversations with history and per-chat model selection
Attaches notes, selections, webpages, and images to conversations
Searches local knowledge bases with keywords
Pins Obsidian and plugin commands to the home page and URLs
Writes results back to notes after preview and confirmation
extras: API keys are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage; note writes require confirmation; web search uses Bing, Baidu, or Sogou; requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in AI chat, so users have no single place to ask models with notes, selections, webpages, and images in context.
summary: AI chat home page for Obsidian that streams conversations with notes, selections, webpages, and images, with confirmed write-back to notes.
